title: x7hh.1 leaf: Activation/expiry + channel/RX-commitment/tx-grant fields
description: Specify activation and expiry, common-window units/geometry, receiver-owned channel and RX commitment, and identified TX grants per spec/02b. Reuse standing beacon/Announce/assignment mechanisms; no per-packet reservation protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Semantic fields have exact bounded encoding and authenticated ownership; worked bytes included.
